opportunities.name: Account brief from SEC 10-K and Wikipedia emailed
opportunities.description: For a given company ticker, look up the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an 'Account brief' email to a colleague.
steps: Search the ticker on SEC EDGAR full-text/company search and open the company
Open filings, filter Form 10-K, note latest 10-K filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open article
Read HQ, employee count, CEO from infobox
Open mail compose, set To, Subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Type body summary with HQ, employees, CEO, 10-K date
Discard/send draft

instances.values: HUBS (HubSpot) SEC 10-K lookup started, not completed in trace

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison with local time
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quote amounts in different currencies to USD on Xe, check the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement a quote comparison.
steps: On Xe currency converter set amount and source currency for quote A, target USD, Convert
Repeat for quote B with other currency
Note USD results and which is cheaper
On timeanddate search the supplier city and read current local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>' and body with both conversions, cheaper option, and local time
Discard/send

instances.values: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka, CNC enclosures
8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune, Shipping boxes

opportunities.name: Timezone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, find the time difference on timeanddate's converter, look up holidays in the relevant country, and email ops a sync-scheduling note.
steps: Open Time Zone Converter
Add city 1 and city 2
Read the time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays and pick the country
Note holidays in the target month to avoid
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: <city1> / <city2>, <month>' and body with offset and dates to avoid
Discard/send

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, October, India holidays
New York / Berlin, December, Germany holidays
